reference: Oracle Primavera P6 EPPM REST API Release 26
purpose: Evidence-only reconciliation of the nine non-exact Activity registry seed names. This artifact does not certify implementation, disposition, mutability, or calculation semantics.

mappings.reason: Oracle defines Id as the short activity ID. ObjectId is a separate unique system identifier; no equivalence is asserted.
Oracle defines Name as the activity name.
Oracle exposes the activity owner as a user ID. OwnerIDArray and OwnerNamesArray also exist, so the current string seed cannot yet be certified as the canonical representation.
Oracle defines Status as the current activity status.
Oracle defines Type as the activity type and documents its allowed values.
Oracle exposes CalendarName and CalendarObjectId. The generic seed name Calendar cannot yet be certified as either canonical field.
Oracle documents RemainingEarlyStartDate as the scheduled start of remaining work. Exact interchange aliasing still requires project regression evidence.
Oracle exposes RemainingEarlyFinishDate and RemainingLateFinishDate; the generic seed name does not identify which semantic is intended.
Oracle Release 26 uses LastUpdateUser for the user who last updated the activity; the seed name UpdateUser is not the official Activity field name.

decision_rule: Do not mutate the canonical registry from this evidence alone. Registry type, writable/computed flags, identity semantics, interchange mapping, and regression behavior must be certified separately.
next_step: Use these mappings as the controlled input to the full 275-field typed semantic reconciliation tranche.
